sam: Kicking off v2.20 deploy. Feature flag flow: fast-canary 5% -> 30% after 15m if green -> emergency drain plan ready. Change window 01:00-01:45 UTC. Pin model for canary: rwd-model-2026-04-10.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.20 started on prod-cluster-4. Canary cohort = cohort-fast-canary.

 tori: I'll pin model now: `/infra pin-model --svc rec-v2 --ver rwd-model-2026-04-10` — leaving pin until >=30% stable.

 sam: starting 5%: `/ff toggle rec-fast --to 5 --reason "v2.20 fast canary"`

 deploy-bot: 5% -> success. Telemetry snapshot: error-rate +0.07%, p95 +10ms, mem 60%. Auto-thresholds: error_delta >1.2% or p95 +180ms triggers auto-drain.

 infra: note: if we need emergency drain, use `--force` to bypass guardrails. Also pre-warmed fallback nodes are ready in us-east-1.

 pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert created for ops-oncall. Escalation in 10m if no ACK.

 ops-oncall: standing by. I'll mute non-critical alerts and watch: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, queue depth, embedding throughput.

 deploy-bot: Advancing to 30% in 15m unless any circuit trips.

 tori: quick smoke around 7m in — no NPEs, embedding latency nominal. Logging a small ranking discrepancy in internal-cohort-B. Not blocking.

 sam: If we need to abort quickly, plan: 1) `/ff toggle rec-fast --to 0 --force` 2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.20 --drain 30s` 3) `/infra unpin-model --svc rec-v2`

 tori: oncall exec snippet (curl):
```
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
 "https://api.redwood/flags/rec-fast?action=set&target=0&force=true"
```

 deploy-bot: 30% -> success. Telemetry: error-rate +0.2%, p95 +24ms, mem 64%. No auto-drain.

 ops-oncall: monitoring looks clean. Recommend 45m soak before 100% flip. If we see error_delta >= 0.9% or p95 +120ms sustained, we execute emergency drain.

 sam: agreed. I'll update change window to include fallback run at 03:00 UTC if we need a rollback. Post-deploy note will follow once we either complete 100% or abort. :pray:
